data.text: Friends, my family taught me to leave enough grass for next month. With 100 hectares now, we can graze 50 flocks altogether and let the remaining 50 grow back to 100. How about 10 flocks each? That gives every one of us $10,000 a month without wearing out the pasture our village depends on. I’m willing to stick to that limit, and we can check the totals together each month. John, would you agree?
